mainEntity.name: Can I DIY window opening framing, or should I hire it out?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the wall shows rot, water damage, uneven studs, or signs of load-bearing construction, it’s better to bring in a professional rather than guess. That also applies when the opening is being resized, when utilities are nearby, or when you need the frame to match existing windows exactly. A pro can verify the rough opening, header, and weatherproofing details before the window goes in.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY may be possible for very simple non-structural work, but damaged walls, load-bearing conditions, and resized openings are best handled by a professional. The risk is getting the support or sizing wrong.
